text: On July 19, 2019, the Film, Television and Digital Media Advisory Board elected a Co-Chair for a term of office ending December 31, 2020 and until successor is appointed. The Board will elect a member, who is a member of the public, as Co-Chair for a term of office ending November 14, 2022.
The Film, Television and Digital Media Advisory Board elected Neishaw Ali as Co-Chair of the Film, Television and Digital Media Advisory Board for a term of office ending November 14, 2022.
